name: BLS E-SERVICES LIMITED
summary: BLS E-Services Limited, a technology enabled digital service company, provides assisted E-services and E-governance services in India and internationally. The company offers business correspondents services to banks. It also operates a network of access points that offers essential public utility, social welfare scheme, healthcare, financial, educational, agricultural, and banking services to governments and businesses to citizens in urban, semi-urban, rural, and remote areas. The company was formerly known as BLS E-Services Private Limited and changed its name to BLS E-Services Limited in April 2023. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Gurugram, India. BLS E-Services Limited is a subsidiary of BLS International Services Limited.
